changes: Accessible names include visible language codes, recent-item counts and selected compare labels.
One-product comparisons fit the dialog; multi-product tables have sticky row labels and a localized scroll hint.
The simulated-DOM harness now uses DOM FormData, avoiding a Node/DOM constructor mismatch.
A production artifact check validates sitemap/indexing controls and referenced assets without publishing.
Bundle budgets inspect the active entry referenced by built HTML, so old unused files cannot skew the result.

limitations: No deployment, DNS deletion, certificate renewal, registration purchase or support message was performed in Stage 7.
Viewport emulation does not certify physical iOS/Android or screen-reader behavior. Axe incomplete results remain manual-review signals.
